method: Headless Chrome via CDP. window.requestAnimationFrame was wrapped after load and callbacks were counted by function name: animate = SignatureDishes orbit loop, tick = BrandWordmark crest loop. Each window was 1500 ms. The page was scrolled instantly (scroll-behavior overridden to auto) and allowed to settle for 900 ms before each window.
notes: The SignatureDishes orbit loop produced 0 callbacks while the stage was offscreen, 59 while it was visible, and 0 again after scrolling away. This confirms the pause/resume path, not an FPS improvement.
The navbar crest continued at ~60 callbacks per 1.5 s in every position. The header is fixed, so its canvas is always intersecting and pauseWhenOffscreen does not pause it in this layout.
The absolute callback rate is headless-Chrome-throttled; only the relative on/off counts are meaningful.
No FPS, CPU, memory, or network profile was captured.
